en: "Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
"Tch.{n} So the enemy made off with the chest!"
"O blazing flames,{n} become a storm and destroy the foe..."
"...Deadly lightning, become a flash{n} piercing heaven and earth, and show{n} the murderous foe your true power..."
"...Thunder wind, become a blade raging{n} in the air, and show the horde{n} writhing on the ground your true power..."
"...Absolute ice, become storm fangs{n} that shake heaven and earth, and show{n} the oncoming malice your true power..."
"Water of light,{n} become a shield and guard us."
"Wall! O wall of swirling flame!{n} Bar the enemy's way and{n} grant us the power of protection!"
"Hear my name! Call my name!{n} A proud name, filled with glory!"
"Race across the sky! Pierce the heavens!{n} The ultra-long shot... Range Plus!"
"This one's no ordinary bullet!{n} Round in the chamber!{n} Hammer cocked! Target!"
"Rocks in the sky, clouds on the ground!{n} ......Art of Falling Rocks!"
"The gates connect, O eight gates!{n} ...Art of the Strange Gates...{n} Earth Formation!"
"Magic and strikes, be sealed!{n} Battle arts, be shut away{n} by the Law of Sealing!"
"Come, dragon, dragon of the earth!{n} Open, Gate of Death! Lead on to hell!"
"Come forth... my minions...{n} puppets of the dead...{n} The word that wakes you... Doll..."
"As long as we're after the same rings{n} on the same island, a fight looks{n} like a road we can't get around."
"Then there's no way but to fight.{n} Don't you think so, old lady?"
"Avoiding a fight only ends up{n} putting off a problem that has{n} to be solved anywaaay!"
"Well, that's about the size of it."
"Don't you flinch, {name:6}!{n} You can win this! You're the one{n} I picked, after all!"
"Leave it to me, {name:6}.{n} You saved me, and I shall{n} never let you die."
"Is this... where I die...?{n} ...Yes... a death on the battlefield{n} is fitting... for me, who killed my sister."
"I'm a professor, you know!{n} Time to gather live combat data!{n} I'm devoted to my work, I am!"
"Target confirmed. Commencing combat!{n} 13B unit at full operation!{n} Leave this battle to me!"
"I see. This, too, is a battle that{n} cannot be avoided, ordained by the{n} flow of ki: one we must not lose."
"I'm sorry, Lady {name:6}!{n} I never thought it would{n} come to this!"
"You're an army chaplain, aren't you?{n} The ones you should worry about now{n} aren't me. They're your comrades!"
"No one can do two things at once.{n} If you can't save both friend and{n} foe, then at least save your friends."
"Yup! Tons and tons of fun!{n} 'Cause I finally found a prince{n} who's all my own!"
"My cursed, uncanny power serves to{n} protect the one who saved me.{n} Nothing could gladden me more."
"Try as often as you like, it ends the{n} same! In the end the strong win!{n} That's the battlefield's one rule!"
"For my husband Hector's sake too,{n} who gave his very life trying to{n} seal away this island's treasure!"
"Hector, huh. I see.{n} So you came to this island to carry{n} on your husband's dying wish."
"That is not all!{n} I came so that the same kind{n} of sorrow is never repeated!"
"Then try and beat me!{n} Justice with no power behind it is{n} worth less than shit on the road!"
"The strength of my husband Hector,{n} who tried to seal this island's{n} treasure, dwells in this arm!"
"He tried to seal away this island's{n} treasure, and was killed by{n} comrades from his own army!"
"Pathetic. So in the end you're{n} just here for revenge too."
"If I'm wrong, then beat me{n} once more and prove it right here!"
"I will beat you!{n} As many times as it takes!"
"You're a stubborn one.{n} A wound like this won't be{n} any big deal for you."
"I'm a creature of whim.{n} Clear out while you still can."
{n} will be in our care from now on."
"You should still be able to walk.{n} Please leave this place at once."
"Hmph...{w:1} Pity your enemy...{w:1} in battle{n} and someday...{w:1} from behind...{w:1}{n} you'll get cut down."
"Then that will simply be my fate."
"If I had any choice at all,{n} I wouldn't want to fight anymore."
"Everyone else...{w:1} is wounded too.{n} Let's...{w:1} rest here for a while."
"Isn't that Ayame!?{n} Hey, that's you over there,{n} isn't it, Ayame?"
"Is she a friend of yooours,{n} Ayame dear?"
"Alice and I are both Esper Dolls,{n} of the Rhodes army's{n} Esper Girl Corps."
"I thought all my friends in the{n} Esper Girl Corps had died!"
"It is the same for me. To meet again{n} alive... nothing could gladden me{n} more. Truly, I am glad you are safe."
"Oho!? A tearful reunion of two{n} lovely girls! Beautiful! Too{n} beautiful! I'm moved something fierce!"
"Tch! Damn Esper Dolls! They're{n} the reason the order came down{n} for us Rhodes troops to retreat!"
"Don't get heated, Parsifal.{n} Keep your hands off for now.{n} We watch a little longer."
"Hey! Hey! Hey!{n} Never mind that, Ayame, you{n} come along with me too! Okay!?"
"Prince {hero:6} is wonderful!{n} So come on, Ayame, you too!"
"Why why why why why why whyyy!?{n} Ayame, could it be...{n} you hate Alice now?"
"But this old lady here,{n} {name:6}, saved my life and{n} blessed me with peace of heart."
"No... I mean... Ayame dear... like{n} I keep telling you... it's...{n} 'young lady'... if you pleeease."
"Therefore I cannot go with you, Alice."
"Will you not come with me instead?{n} {name:6} is a great fool, but as{n} truly kind as a holy mother."
"Ever since I met {name:6},{n} I have felt a deep peace of heart{n} such as I had never known."
"No no no no no no no!{n} I can't do that!{n} Leave Prince {hero:6}!?"
"Because I already gave my heart and{n} my body to Prince {hero:6}!"
"It will mean we fight.{n} You accept that?"
"It can't be helped.{n} It just can't be helped, right?"
"Each for the one she believes in."
"But if it's you, Ayame, it's okay!{n} Even if I get killed or torn to{n} pieces, I'll forgive you!"
"In the end, even old friends wind{n} up fighting. That's the law of{n} this island of steel."
"Hey, Aerial. You do remember our{n} promise from the other day, right?"
"Next time we met that woman, you'd{n} get your hands dirty too."
"That's what I told you, isn't it?"
"That's all right, Aerial.{n} Please, don't you worry{n} about meee."
"This time, instead of a ring,{n} I'm taking half your cash."
"I'm terribly sorry, but this time{n} I'll be taking haaalf your money."
"I'll use it with caaare.{n} So please forgive me, okaaay..."
